annotations.title: List mobile operators and plans for a country

description: Mobile recharge without a phone number yet: lists the mobile operators Slashtel can top up in one country, with sample live plans for each (what the recipient receives, validity and price in USD) and the page to cite. Use it when someone asks what they can send to a country or an operator, for example 'recargas Telcel', 'recharge Maroc Telecom', 'Vodafone Egypt plans' or 'Jio plans from abroad'. To buy, ask for the full number and call get_topup_plans.

country.description: ISO-2 country code of the number to top up, e.g. IN, MX, EG, MA, PK, PH

operator.description: Optional operator name to narrow to, e.g. Telcel, Jio, Vodafone

name: get_topup_operators
